display_fil:
Sabay ang baha at evacuation advisory.
May pamilyang kailangan ng tulong sa paglikas.
Nauubos ang gamot; hindi tiyak ang tubig.
Pagod ang volunteer.
display_en:
Flooding and an evacuation advisory coincide.
A family needs help leaving; medicine runs low.
Shelter water is uncertain.
A volunteer is exhausted.
narration_fil: Sa fictional tabletop, may baha at evacuation advisory. May pamilyang kailangan ng tulong sa paglikas. Nauubos ang gamot ng residente. Hindi tiyak ang tubig; pagod ang volunteer.
narration_en: In a fictional tabletop, flooding and an evacuation advisory coincide. A family needs help leaving, a resident’s medicine is running low, shelter water is uncertain and a volunteer is exhausted.

narration_fil: Suriin ang opisyal na babala at lokal na plano. Magtalaga ng kumpirmadong contact sa evacuation, clinical continuity, WASH at psychosocial support. Iulat ang agarang panganib sa tamang team, kumpirmahin ang handover, at magtakda ng follow-up. Magpahinga at humingi ng suporta ang responder kung hindi ligtas magpatuloy.
narration_en: Check the official warning and local plan. Identify confirmed contacts for evacuation, clinical continuity, WASH and psychosocial support. Report immediate risk to the right team, confirm handover, and set follow-up. A responder should rest and seek support when it is unsafe to continue.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Sabay-sabay ang apat na isyu. Saan magsisimula ang grupo?
check.prompt_en: Four issues arrive together. Where does the group start?

options.fil: Unahin ang gamot, dahil nauubos na ito.
options.en: Start with the medicine, because it is running out.

options.fil: Unahin ang kaligtasan; iugnay ang serbisyo, kumpirmahin ang handover at follow-up.
options.en: Prioritize safety; link services, confirm handover and follow-up.

options.fil: Sabihan ang pagod na volunteer na magpatuloy hanggang matapos ang pagtugon.
options.en: Tell the exhausted volunteer to keep going until the response is over.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Mahalaga ito, pero unahin kung sino ang nasa panganib ngayon. 2: Una ang ligtas na paglikas; saka ipapasa ang bawat isyu sa kumpirmadong lead na may follow-up. 3: Dapat magpahinga at humingi ng suporta ang responder kung hindi ligtas magpatuloy.
check.feedback_en: 1: It matters, but first ask who is in danger right now. 2: Safe evacuation comes first; then each issue goes to a confirmed lead with follow-up. 3: A responder should rest and seek support when it is unsafe to continue.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
1. Ligtas na paglikas at agarang referral.
2. Gamot at tubig sa tamang staff.
3. Itala ang pagtanggap.
4. Follow-up at kapalit sa pagod na volunteer.
display_en:
1. Safe evacuation and urgent referral.
2. Medicine and water to the right staff.
3. Record acknowledgement.
4. Follow-up and relief for the volunteer.
narration_fil: Inuna ng grupo ang ligtas na paglilikas at agarang referral. Ipinasa ang gamot at tubig sa tamang staff at itinala ang pagtanggap. Nagtakda sila ng follow-up at kapalit sa pagod na volunteer.
narration_en: The group prioritizes safe evacuation and urgent referral. It routes medicine and water to the appropriate staff, records acknowledgement, and arranges follow-up and relief for the exhausted volunteer.

display_fil:
Tabletop lamang: hindi incident command,
clinical assessment, tubig testing o live drill.
Kumpirmahin ang lahat ng contact at ruta.
display_en:
Tabletop only: not incident command,
clinical assessment, water testing or a live drill.
Verify every contact and route.
narration_fil: Tabletop lamang ito. Hindi kapalit ng opisyal na incident command, clinical assessment, tubig testing o live drill. Kumpirmahin ang lahat ng contact at ruta bago gamitin.
narration_en: This is a tabletop only. It does not replace official incident command, clinical assessment, water testing or a live drill. Verify every contact and route before use.

display_fil:
Ano ang susunod na hakbang?
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the next step?
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: May lead na ang bawat isyu. Ano ang ligtas na susunod na hakbang?
check.prompt_en: Each issue now has a lead. What is the safe next step?

options.fil: Iwanang walang kapalit ang pagod na responder at walang follow-up ang referral.
options.en: Leave the exhausted responder without relief and the referral without follow-up.

options.fil: Itala ang bawat pagtanggap, magtakda ng follow-up at kapalit ng volunteer.
options.en: Record each acknowledgement, set follow-up and relieve the volunteer.

options.fil: Gamitin ang anumang contact na naaalala mo kahit hindi ito kumpirmado.
options.en: Use any contact you remember, even if it is not confirmed.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Maaaring makapinsala o maantala ang tulong: kailangan ng follow-up ang volunteer at ang referral. 2: Sa naitalang pagtanggap at follow-up, may may-ari ang bawat isyu, kasama ang pag-aalaga sa responder. 3: Kumpirmahin ang lahat ng contact at ruta bago gamitin.
check.feedback_en: 1: This may harm or delay help: the volunteer and the referral both need follow-up. 2: Recorded acknowledgement and follow-up keep every issue owned, including responder care. 3: Verify every contact and route before use.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
Sa Lunes: ipa-review ang tabletop record
sa DRRM at health leads. Itala ang puwang
sa plano at petsa ng susunod na pagsasanay.
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, ipa-review ang tabletop record sa DRRM at health leads. Itala ang puwang sa lokal na plano at petsa ng muling pagsasanay.
narration_en: On Monday, ask DRRM and health leads to review the tabletop record; add identified gaps to the local plan and date the next exercise.
